question: Should the repository adopt this exact-head credential-separated repair publication architecture for guarded production rollout once the remaining hosted check passes?
rationale: The implementation changes trusted workflow jobs, credential scopes, proof authority, mutation boundaries, and recovery behavior, so production adoption requires explicit operator ownership even without a code defect.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Merge the exact reviewed head after pnpm check passes and monitor the first production repair executions under existing pause controls.

options.title: Hold for deployment rehearsal
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers complete another production-like rehearsal or define a narrower staged deployment.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
